scope: Repair the lock-step January-July replay startup path without changing any causal score, target, model, policy, EV-map, or portfolio rule. The replay now projects the multi-million-row strict prequential parquet ledger to the exact union of its frozen 120 base fields, identity/prequential handoff fields, H12 supervision fields, and stored canonical policy supervision fields. policy_outcome_source is deliberately excluded because it is created only by the post-read canonical-outcome join and is not a parquet field.
